Founder's desk: the day's tape, two facts set against each other

queue.body: $ADM is 3.7% from its 5-year high, four green weeks in a row.

queue.headline: $DYN -16.4% on Wednesday
queue.body: DYN crashed -16.4% on Wednesday. The state underneath it: DYN has been back below its 50-day average only a few days, after three months on the other side.
$BABA Congressman sold between $100K and $250K on Jul 24. Filing went public Sep 4, 42 days later. The tape never waits for the disclosure.

accounts.name: Crowd translator — market psychology, mood vs positioning, consumer and tech stories with market consequence

queue.body:
$ALV three straight green closes.
125 entry, 156 first target, 186 second.
Same setup ran five straight in May, six in January.
Line's at 105.
Jobless claims averaging 207k a week this month, 12.5% below a year ago, while GDPNow tracks 4.7% growth. Warm inflation, firming growth.
